sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.569 of 2021 pending on the file of learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Balasore, arising out of Singla P.S. Case No.166 of 2021 for commission of offences punishable under Section 363/ 506/ 366/ 376(2)(n)/
323/ 294 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. This Court perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of BNSS which prima facie does not show any allegation qua the Petitioner.
4. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2 by Speed Post.
Requisites shall be filed by 09.10.2025.
Informant be noticed through the I.O..
Extra copy of the brief for the purpose be served on the learned counsel for the State by 09.10.2025 as well.
5. List this matter on 02.12.2025.

Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
6.
As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
